notes.title: The Inn Between - The Extended Demo
notes.notes:
[h1][b]The Extended Demo for The Inn Between is COMPLETE! [/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41299695/3d46e9abb211096862534ed827312bd64c58adbc.png[/img]

Join us for 52,000 words of our common route, and meet all three of our gorgeous love interests! We invite you to play through approximately half of our common route and immerse yourself in the first chance to experience more of our long awaited story! 

 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41299695/aa181e14456a0cc683cb104d1b2604f8fb2b02c4.png[/img]

The extended demo follows the common route up to chapter six, introduces all our love interests and features a brand new UI overhaul. 

[list]
[*] 52,000 words  
[*] Possible bad ending
[*] Introduces all three romanceable characters 
[*] Eight CGs and thirty unique backgrounds
[*] Original Soundtrack
[*] Catboy 
[/list]

Check out our new demo page and please enjoy our demo update! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1776810/The_Inn_Between_Demo/

notes.title: Kickstarter Update (Fully Funded!)
notes.notes:
Kickstarter! FULLY FUNDED! 

[b]Stretch goals achieved:[/b] Extra Art + NSFW! 

[b]Next up:[/b] Voice Acting, followed by the Fourth Love Interest.


If you saw our last news update or follow us on social you'll have seen that we have a Kickstarter running to get out game funded. 

We've met several goals already but there's still a lot to go! 

To bring our game to you and to be the best it can be we need funding. 


We have several updates and special reveals up on twitter, discord, patreon and kickstarter for teaser art and updates, including a nsfw preview with our fourth love interest and a bust sketch of his design! 

We've also unlocked several social goals including a give away and nsfw art poll to be held on twitter when the campaign ends. 


[u][b]Stretch Goals[/b][/u]

We're working on our 3rd stretch goal [b]Voice Acting[/b] 


If you havent played our demo yet, check out a voice preview of our talented cast below! 


[previewyoutube=CeypajdSUwQ;full][/previewyoutube]


With the voice talents of Edward A. Mendoza, Patrick Mealey, June Yoon and many others our demo showcases the robust talent of the indie community and we hope and aim to be able to bring these voices to you for the entire game with FULL voice acting. 


If you'd like to help us reach our goals you can back us here: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/catslilypad/the-inn-between-visual-novel?ref=dm4prq]The Inn Between: A BL / BxB Visual Novel[/url]

notes.title: The Inn Between: Funding Campaign
notes.notes:
If you're familiar with indie visual novels you've probably seen the process of development time and again. 

If you played our demo and would like to see more, or even if you havent yet and are waiting for the full release. 

We're now on Kickstarter! 

The only way we can make this game if by this campaign is a success. 

We have numerous tiers to choose from with both digital goods and physical merch as well as tiers to create your own custom character, creature or background!! 


Our goals range from extra art, NSFW, Voice Acting, all the way to a 4th Love Interest! 

You can check out our Twitter, Discord or Kickstarter updates for special illustrations and keep up to date with news, including previews of our Fourth Love Interest! 



Above all else, 

Thank you for playing The Inn Between.
